```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = F, message = F)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(ggsci)
library(glue)
theme_set(theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = 'bottom'))
```



```{r}
# server job array run (see array_job/combine_and_summarize.py); overrides the file above.
# sim_name is only used to name the saved figures here
sim_name = '2d_expanse_m1000'
file ='C:/Users/jiyue/OneDrive - UC San Diego/python_projects/corr/array_job/sim_summary.xlsx'

sim_all_raw = read_xlsx(file)


sim_all = sim_all_raw %>% 
  mutate(rho_plot = paste0('rho==', rho)) %>% 
  mutate(M_method_plot = recode(M, 'cubic_root' = 'n^0.3', 'linear' = '0.2n', 
                                'auto' = 'n^(d/d+2)')) %>% 
  mutate(constant_fct = as.factor(constant)) %>% 
  mutate(distribution = ifelse(distribution == 'gaussian'& trans %in% 'square',
                               'chisq1', distribution)) %>%
  # earlier method codes, renamed in src.py, mapped to the current ones
  mutate(method = recode(method, hac = 'general', hac_gaussian = 'gauss', huristic = 'indep')) %>%
  # legend order as in the paper; any other method codes follow these
  mutate(method = fct_relevel(factor(method),
                              intersect(c('general', 'gauss', 'indep', 'iid'), unique(method))))

# number of observed points: n_obs is recorded for runs with a mask; older runs use the full grid
if (!'n_obs' %in% names(sim_all)) sim_all$n_obs = NA_real_
sim_all = sim_all %>% mutate(n_obs = coalesce(n_obs, nx^n_dim))

# x axis for plots against the number of points, on a log scale since n_obs grows like nx^d
x_lab_n = 'Number of points (N)'
scale_x_n = scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma())
```

```{r}
# number of replications per setting, from the m_sim column of the results
n_sim = unique(sim_all$m_sim)
if (length(n_sim) != 1) stop('settings use different m_sim values: ', paste(n_sim, collapse = ', '))
alpha = 0.05
se = sqrt(alpha*(1-alpha)/n_sim)
```


```{r}
# plot a summary measure against the number of points, one colour per method
# facets: any facet_grid formula, e.g. rho_plot ~ fwhm, fwhm ~ distribution, ~ fwhm
# y, target, ylab: e.g. y = power, target = alpha, ylab = 'Type I error rate' for type I error
# method_labels: named vector mapping method codes to legend names, e.g. labels_ci below
# linetype: optional column for line types, e.g. linetype = M_method_plot to compare bandwidths,
#   with linetype_name as its legend title
# caption: if TRUE, shows the dimension, distribution and dependence design (dep_model) in the data
# distribution: optional subset, e.g. 'gaussian', 'chisq1' or c('gaussian', 'chisq1');
#   NULL (default) keeps all distributions in the data
# dep_model: optional subset of dependence designs, e.g. 'shift', 'symmetric_shift', or 'none'
#   for rows without a design (missing dep_model); NULL (default) keeps all designs
plot_by_method = function(data, facets = rho_plot ~ fwhm, y = cover_rate, target = 1 - alpha,
                          ylab = 'Coverage rate', caption = FALSE, method_labels = waiver(),
                          linetype = NULL, linetype_name = 'Bandwidth', distribution = NULL,
                          dep_model = NULL){
  # a missing dep_model (or no dep_model column) means X and Y depend only through rho
  dep_of = function(d) {
    if ('dep_model' %in% names(d)) coalesce(as.character(d$dep_model), 'none') else rep('none', nrow(d))
  }
  if (!is.null(distribution)) {
    # .data is the column and .env the argument, which have the same name
    data = data %>% filter(.data$distribution %in% .env$distribution)
    if (nrow(data) == 0) stop('no rows with distribution ', paste(distribution, collapse = ', '))
  }
  if (!is.null(dep_model)) {
    data = data[dep_of(data) %in% dep_model, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(data) == 0) stop('no rows with dep_model ', paste(dep_model, collapse = ', '))
  }
  # 95% Monte Carlo band around the nominal level
  half_width = 1.96 * sqrt(target * (1 - target) / n_sim)
  if (caption) {
    dep = unique(dep_of(data))
    caption = glue('# dimension: {paste(unique(data$n_dim), collapse = ", ")}, ',
                   'distribution: {paste(unique(data$distribution), collapse = ", ")}, ',
                   'dependence design: {paste(dep, collapse = ", ")}')
  } else {
    caption = NULL
  }
  facet_labeller = labeller(
    rho_plot = label_parsed,
    fwhm = as_labeller(function(x) paste0('FWHM = ', x)),
    distribution = as_labeller(c(gaussian = 'Gaussian', chisq1 = 'chi[1]^2'), default = label_parsed),
    .default = label_both)
  data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = n_obs, y = {{ y }}, color = method, linetype = {{ linetype }})) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = target, linetype = 'dashed') +
    geom_hline(yintercept = target + half_width, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'darkgray') +
    geom_hline(yintercept = target - half_width, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'darkgray') +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(size = 1.4) +
    facet_grid(facets, labeller = facet_labeller) +
    # fixed colour per method (method_colors), so a method keeps its colour when others are
    # filtered out of a plot
    scale_color_manual(name = 'Method', values = method_colors, labels = method_labels) +
    scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
    labs(x = x_lab_n, y = ylab, caption = caption, linetype = linetype_name) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = 'bottom',
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}

# legend names matching the method names in the paper (check against the code's method codes):
# labels_ci for confidence intervals (coverage), labels_test for tests (Type I error, power)
labels_ci = c(general = 'RFCorr', gauss = 'RFCorr-Gauss', indep = 'RFCorr-Indep', iid = 'naive')
# colour of each method in every figure, the first four d3 colours in the paper's method order,
# so the naive method (iid) is always red even when another method is left out of a plot
method_colors = setNames(pal_d3()(4), c('general', 'gauss', 'indep', 'iid'))
labels_test = c(general = 'RFCorr-0', gauss = 'RFCorr-Gauss-0', indep = 'RFCorr-Indep',
                iid = 'naive')
```

```{r}
# coverage colored by method, fixed bandwidth rule, one figure per distribution and design
sim_all_plot = sim_all %>% filter(M == 'auto')
# design of each row; a missing dep_model (or no dep_model column) means no design ('none')
dep_col = if ('dep_model' %in% names(sim_all_plot)) {
  coalesce(as.character(sim_all_plot$dep_model), 'none')
} else {
  rep('none', nrow(sim_all_plot))
}
# file-name tag for each design; no tag without a design, any other design is tagged by its name
dep_tags = c(none = '', shift = '_shift', symmetric_shift = '_symmetric')
dep_tag = function(dep) if (dep %in% names(dep_tags)) dep_tags[[dep]] else paste0('_', dep)

for (dist in intersect(c('gaussian', 'chisq1'), unique(sim_all_plot$distribution))) {
  for (dep in unique(dep_col)) {
    # skip combinations with no rows (e.g. a design run only with Gaussian fields)
    if (!any(sim_all_plot$distribution == dist & dep_col == dep)) next
    p = plot_by_method(sim_all_plot, distribution = dist, dep_model = dep, caption = TRUE,
                       method_labels = labels_ci)
    print(p)
    ggsave(glue('coverage_{sim_name}_by_method_{dist}{dep_tag(dep)}.jpg'), plot = p,
           width = 8, height = 6)
  }
}

# coverage by rho for one FWHM: one panel per rho, in increasing order of rho. Only rows
# without a design, since the dependence designs are run with rho = 0 only
fwhm_fixed = 2
sim_rho_plot = sim_all_plot[dep_col == 'none', ] %>%
  filter(fwhm == fwhm_fixed) %>%
  mutate(rho_plot = fct_reorder(rho_plot, rho))

for (dist in intersect(c('gaussian', 'chisq1'), unique(sim_rho_plot$distribution))) {
  # facet_wrap replaces the facet_grid of plot_by_method, so the panels wrap into a grid
  p = plot_by_method(sim_rho_plot, distribution = dist, dep_model = 'none', caption = TRUE,
                     method_labels = labels_ci) +
    facet_wrap(~rho_plot, labeller = label_parsed, ncol = 4) +
    labs(title = glue('FWHM = {fwhm_fixed}'))
  print(p)
  ggsave(glue('coverage_{sim_name}_by_rho_{dist}_fwhm{fwhm_fixed}.jpg'), plot = p,
         width = 8, height = 8)
}

```


```{r}
# Type I error rate colored by method: rho = 0, fixed bandwidth rule,
# one figure per distribution and dependence design present in the data
sim_all_plot = sim_all %>% filter(M == 'auto', rho == 0)
# designs in the data; a missing dep_model (or no dep_model column) means no design ('none')
deps = if ('dep_model' %in% names(sim_all_plot)) {
  unique(coalesce(as.character(sim_all_plot$dep_model), 'none'))
} else {
  'none'
}
# file-name tag for each design; no tag without a design, as in the earlier file names
dep_tags = c(none = '', shift = '_shift', symmetric_shift = '_symmetric')

for (dist in intersect(c('gaussian', 'chisq1'), unique(sim_all_plot$distribution))) {
  for (dep in deps) {
    p = plot_by_method(sim_all_plot, facets = ~fwhm, y = power, target = alpha,
                       ylab = 'Type I error rate', distribution = dist, dep_model = dep,
                       caption = TRUE, method_labels = labels_test)
    print(p)
    ggsave(glue('type1_error_{sim_name}_by_method_{dist}{dep_tags[[dep]]}.jpg'), plot = p,
           width = 8, height = 6)
  }
}



```


```{r}
# for the paper (labels_ci and labels_test are defined with plot_by_method)

# coverage for one rho, both distributions
plot_by_method(sim_all %>% filter(M == 'auto', rho == 0.4)%>%
filter(method !='indep'), facets = distribution~fwhm, dep_model = 'none',
               method_labels = labels_ci)

ggsave(glue('Fig1_coverage.jpg'), width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 600)
# type I error, both distributions, independent fields (no dependence design)
plot_by_method(sim_all %>% filter(M == 'auto', rho == 0)
#%filter(method %in% c('indep', 'iid'))
,
facets = distribution ~ fwhm, dep_model = 'none',
               y = power, target = alpha, ylab = 'Type I error rate', method_labels = labels_test)

ggsave(glue('Fig2_type1err.jpg'), width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 600)
# type I error under the symmetric shift design (rho = 0 but X and Y dependent)
plot_by_method(sim_all %>% filter(M == 'auto', rho == 0),
facets = distribution ~ fwhm, dep_model = 'symmetric_shift',
               y = power, target = alpha, ylab = 'Type I error rate', method_labels = labels_test)

ggsave(glue('Fig3_type1err_symmetric.jpg'), width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 600)

# supplementary: coverage by rho for one FWHM, without RFCorr-Indep; one panel per rho in
# increasing order, and a caption with only the distribution and FWHM.
# FigS1 for chi^2_1 fields, FigS2 for Gaussian fields
figS_fwhm = 2
figS_number = c(chisq1 = 1, gaussian = 2)
for (dist in names(figS_number)) {
  p = plot_by_method(sim_all %>%
                       filter(M == 'auto', fwhm == figS_fwhm, method != 'indep') %>%
                       mutate(rho_plot = fct_reorder(rho_plot, rho)),
                     distribution = dist, dep_model = 'none', method_labels = labels_ci) +
    facet_wrap(~rho_plot, labeller = label_parsed, ncol = 4) +
    labs(caption = glue('distribution: {dist}, FWHM: {figS_fwhm}'))
  print(p)
  ggsave(glue('FigS{figS_number[[dist]]}_coverage_by_rho_{dist}_fwhm{figS_fwhm}.jpg'), plot = p,
         width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 600)
}
```
